title: Jesus Dies on the Cross
summary: Jesus gave His life to save sinners. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 23:33-49 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus gave His life to save sinners.

tell_it: Jesus was crucified between criminals. Even while suffering, He showed mercy and trusted the Father.
understand_it: Jesus gave His life to save sinners. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus Dies on the Cross reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Jesus is the Savior.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus Dies on the Cross shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus gave His life to save sinners.
teen_explanation: Jesus Dies on the Cross gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus gave His life to save sinners. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus gave His life to save sinners.
Jesus gave Himself to save sinners.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when jesus saves is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Where did Jesus die?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: On the cross. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus gave His life to save sinners.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Luke 23:46 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jesus Dies on the Cross?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Mercy at the Cross
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus gave His life to save sinners.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jesus Dies on the Cross. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
